# OmicsKit

`OmicsKit` is an R package that streamlines multi-omics analyses in
genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and methylomics by simplifying
data handling, generating publication-quality visualizations, and
offering flexible utilities to accelerate end-to-end analysis.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Installation

Install the dependencies with the following:

``` r

# Install CRAN packages
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("stats")
install.packages("matrixStats")
install.packages("umap")
install.packages("tsne")
install.packages("magrittr")
install.packages("rlang")
install.packages("tibble")
install.packages("remotes")
```

You can install the development version of `OmicsKit` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# Install from GitHub
remotes::install_github("BigMindLab/OmicsKit")

# Call library for usage
library("OmicsKit")
```

For a more detailed Differential Expression Analysis workflow using the
`OmicsKit` suite, see [BigMind](https://github.com/BigMindLab)’s GitHub
organization and its custom [DESeq2
pipeline](https://github.com/BigMindLab/DESeq2).

# Package index

## Differential Expression Analysis (DEA)

Functions for data quality control, normalization, dimensionality
reduction, annotation, and differential expression visualization.

- [`power_analysis()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/power_analysis.md)
  : Power analysis for RNA-seq differential expression with optional
  plotting
- [`tpm()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/tpm.md) :
  Function to calculate the TPMs from a table of raw gene counts.
- [`nice_PCA()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/nice_PCA.md)
  : Function to make nice PCA plots
- [`nice_UMAP()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/nice_UMAP.md)
  : Function to make UMAP plots.
- [`nice_tSNE()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/nice_tSNE.md)
  : Function to make tSNE plots.
- [`get_annotations()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/get_annotations.md)
  : Get gene or transcript annotations from Ensembl BioMart.
- [`add_annotations()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/add_annotations.md)
  : A function to add annotations to a table of gene counts.
- [`save_results()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/save_results.md)
  : Save the results of a Differential Expression analysis
- [`split_cases()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/split_cases.md)
  : Obtain 10 exclusive cases from 3 comparisons.
- [`nice_Volcano()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/nice_Volcano.md)
  : Function to draw Volcano plots.
- [`detect_filter()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/detect_filter.md)
  : Find detectable genes across comparisons.
- [`get_stars()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/get_stars.md)
  : Obtain annotations to display significance.
- [`nice_VSB()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/nice_VSB.md)
  : Function to make Violin-Scatter-Box plots from data frames.
- [`nice_VSB_DEseq2()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/nice_VSB_DEseq2.md)
  : Function to make Box-Scatter-Violin plots from DEseq2 output
  directly.
- [`trend_filter()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/trend_filter.md)
  : Filter genes by patient-level trend consistency.

## Cross-Layer Concordance

Tools for comparing differential expression results and correlating
expression values across omics layers (e.g., RNA vs. RPPA).

- [`concordanceDE()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/concordanceDE.md)
  : Classify differential results by cross-layer concordance.
- [`crossLayerCorr()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/crossLayerCorr.md)
  : Correlate paired sample profiles between two omics layers.
- [`nice_ConcordanceScatter()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/nice_ConcordanceScatter.md)
  : Plot cross-layer log-fold-change concordance.

## Survival & Clinical Modeling

Survival analysis, Cox/GLM modeling, and related visualization
utilities.

- [`nice_KM()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/nice_KM.md)
  : Function to generate Kaplan Meier survival plots for a given binary
  gene variable
- [`get_cox()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/get_cox.md)
  : Fit Cox Proportional Hazards Models and Return a Tidy Table
- [`get_glm()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/get_glm.md)
  : Function to Fit a GLM and Return Tidy Results with Effect Sizes and
  FDR Correction
- [`nice_forest()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/nice_forest.md)
  : Draw a Forest Plot from Cox Model Results
- [`nice_ROC()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/nice_ROC.md)
  : Plot and Compare ROC Curves for Binary Classification Models

## Pathway Analysis (PA)

Tools for loading, merging, and visualizing GSEA / pathway analysis
results, including single- and multi-comparison plots and heatmaps.

- [`list_gmts()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/list_gmts.md)
  : Read GMT files from a directory into a named gene set list
- [`merge_PA()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/merge_PA.md)
  : Merge GSEA result files into a single data frame
- [`getgenesPA()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/getgenesPA.md)
  : Extract gene members from pathway analysis results
- [`addgenesPA()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/addgenesPA.md)
  : Add gene columns to pathway analysis results
- [`multiplot_PA()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/multiplot_PA.md)
  : Pathway analysis visualization across multiple comparisons
- [`splot_PA()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/splot_PA.md)
  : Pathway analysis visualization for a single comparison
- [`heatmap_PA()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/heatmap_PA.md)
  : Plot leading edge heatmaps from pathway analysis results
- [`heatmap_path_PA()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/heatmap_path_PA.md)
  : Plot leading edge heatmaps from GSEA analysis results using file
  paths

## PA Clustering

Pathway clustering via Jaccard similarity, hierarchical clustering, and
network-based community detection.

- [`geneset_similarity()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/geneset_similarity.md)
  : Compute Jaccard similarity and distance matrices for gene sets
- [`do_clust()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/do_clust.md)
  : Hierarchical clustering of gene sets with silhouette-based
  optimization
- [`get_superterm()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/get_superterm.md)
  : Generate representative super-term labels for gene set communities
- [`get_network_communities()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/get_network_communities.md)
  : Detect gene set communities and generate super-term labels
- [`network_clust()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/network_clust.md)
  : Gene set network clustering with igraph base R graphics
- [`network_clust_gg()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/network_clust_gg.md)
  : Gene set network clustering with ggraph graphics

## Genome & Circos Visualization

Genome build resolution, Ensembl species/version lookups, and
circos-style genome track plotting.

- [`is_circos_genome()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/is_circos_genome.md)
  : Test whether an object is a circos genome descriptor
- [`resolve_genome()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/resolve_genome.md)
  : Resolve cytoband and chromosome order for circos plots
- [`list_ensembl_species()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/list_ensembl_species.md)
  : List all species datasets available in a given Ensembl version.
- [`list_ensembl_versions()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/list_ensembl_versions.md)
  : List available Ensembl releases and their BioMart hosts.
- [`nice_circos()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/nice_circos.md)
  : Plot genome-wide circos tracks for multi-omics data
- [`nice_GenomeTrack()`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/nice_GenomeTrack.md)
  : Plot genomic tracks with gene annotations and optional data tracks.
- [`print(`*`<circos_genome>`*`)`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/print.circos_genome.md)
  : Print a circos genome descriptor

## Example datasets

TCGA-BRCA datasets shipped with the package for reproducible examples
and vignettes.

- [`brca_clinical_modeling_data`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_clinical_modeling_data.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA clinical modeling dataset
- [`brca_concordance_rna_rppa_er`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_concordance_rna_rppa_er.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA RNA-RPPA concordance results
- [`brca_crosslayercorr_rna_rppa_er`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_crosslayercorr_rna_rppa_er.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA RNA-RPPA cross-layer correlations
- [`brca_geneset_list`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_geneset_list.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA MSigDB gene-set list
- [`brca_metadata`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_metadata.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA metadata
- [`brca_omics_layer_tracks`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_omics_layer_tracks.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA omics-layer figure provenance
- [`brca_pa_clustering`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_pa_clustering.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA pathway clustering object
- [`brca_pa_merged`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_pa_merged.md)
  : Merged TCGA-BRCA pathway-analysis results
- [`brca_pa_results`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_pa_results.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA pathway-analysis results
- [`brca_pa_similarity`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_pa_similarity.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA pathway similarity object
- [`brca_ranked_genes`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_ranked_genes.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA ranked gene symbols
- [`brca_rna_dea_er_pos_vs_er_neg`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_rna_dea_er_pos_vs_er_neg.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA RNA-seq DEA: ER-positive versus ER-negative
- [`brca_rna_dea_tumor_vs_normal`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_rna_dea_tumor_vs_normal.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA RNA-seq DEA: tumor versus normal
- [`brca_rna_expr_er_shared_filtered`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_rna_expr_er_shared_filtered.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA RNA expression matrix for ER comparison
- [`brca_rna_expr_tumor_normal_filtered`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_rna_expr_tumor_normal_filtered.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA RNA expression matrix for tumor-normal comparison
- [`brca_rna_metadata_er_shared`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_rna_metadata_er_shared.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA RNA metadata for ER comparison
- [`brca_rna_metadata_tumor_normal`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_rna_metadata_tumor_normal.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA RNA metadata for tumor-normal comparison
- [`brca_rna_vst_or_logexpr_small`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_rna_vst_or_logexpr_small.md)
  : Small TCGA-BRCA transformed RNA expression matrix
- [`brca_rppa_dea_gene_er_pos_vs_er_neg`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_rppa_dea_gene_er_pos_vs_er_neg.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA RPPA gene-level DEA
- [`brca_rppa_expr_gene_er_shared`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_rppa_expr_gene_er_shared.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA RPPA gene-level expression matrix

## Internal / Unused Pipeline Objects

Intermediate data-raw pipeline outputs, superseded by the consolidated
objects above and not currently loaded by any vignette. Kept for
pipeline provenance; excluded from the built package via .Rbuildignore.

- [`brca_clinical_level_summary_pfi`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_clinical_level_summary_pfi.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA clinical PFI level summary
- [`brca_clinical_modeling_log`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_clinical_modeling_log.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA clinical modeling log
- [`brca_clinical_ref_template`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_clinical_ref_template.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA clinical reference template
- [`brca_cox_adjusted_clinical`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_cox_adjusted_clinical.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA adjusted Cox results
- [`brca_cox_univariable_clinical`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_cox_univariable_clinical.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA univariable Cox results
- [`brca_geneset_list_by_collection`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_geneset_list_by_collection.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA MSigDB gene-set list by collection
- [`brca_glm_stage_clinical`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_glm_stage_clinical.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA clinical GLM results
- [`brca_glm_stage_predictions`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_glm_stage_predictions.md)

- [`brca_glm_stage_test`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_glm_stage_test.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA GLM test data
- [`brca_glm_stage_train`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_glm_stage_train.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA GLM training data
- [`brca_gsea_all_comparisons_hallmark_go_bp`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_gsea_all_comparisons_hallmark_go_bp.md)
  : Merged TCGA-BRCA GSEAPreranked results
- [`brca_gsea_er_pos_vs_er_neg_go_bp`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_gsea_er_pos_vs_er_neg_go_bp.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA GSEAPreranked GO BP: ER-positive versus ER-negative
- [`brca_gsea_er_pos_vs_er_neg_hallmark`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_gsea_er_pos_vs_er_neg_hallmark.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA GSEAPreranked Hallmark: ER-positive versus ER-negative
- [`brca_gsea_er_pos_vs_er_neg_hallmark_go`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_gsea_er_pos_vs_er_neg_hallmark_go.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA PA object: ER-positive versus ER-negative
- [`brca_gsea_pipeline_metadata`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_gsea_pipeline_metadata.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA GSEA pipeline metadata
- [`brca_gsea_tumor_vs_normal_go_bp`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_gsea_tumor_vs_normal_go_bp.md)
  : TCGA-BRCA GSEAPreranked GO BP: tumor versus normal

  : TCGA-BRCA PA object: tumor versus normal
- [`brca_pa_pathway_metadata`](https://danielgarbozo.github.io/OmicsKit/reference/brca_pa_pathway_metadata.md)

  : TCGA-BRCA ranked gene scores

  : TCGA-BRCA clinical ROC object
